'''Burst Lasers''' fire a short burst of several shots per trigger pull, sitting between the single-shot [[Pulse Laser]] and the continuous [[Beam Laser]] in both heat generation and sustained damage output.

== Overview ==

Because each trigger pull fires multiple rounds, Burst Lasers can land more total damage per pull than a Pulse Laser without the constant capacitor and thermal load of a Beam Laser, making them a common middle-ground choice for Commanders balancing sustained damage against heat management. As a thermal weapon, ammunition is unlimited and governed by the ship's Power Distributor rather than a physical magazine.
